name: When do I need new window opening framing?

mainEntity.name: When do I need new window opening framing?

acceptedAnswer.text: New window opening framing is typically needed when you are installing new windows where none existed before, enlarging an existing window opening, or relocating a window. It's also essential if existing framing is damaged due to water, pests, or structural shifts, or if you're upgrading to significantly heavier windows that require stronger support. A professional assessment can determine the specific framing requirements for your project, ensuring safety and compliance with building codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: New framing is needed for new window installations, enlarging openings, relocating windows, or if existing framing is damaged or insufficient for heavier windows.
